Method of Attack: Supply-chain attack via altered Bash Uploader script
Replacing Codecov's IP address with attacker-controlled IP in Bash Uploader script
Silent collection of customer credentials including tokens, API keys, and environment variables from CI environments
Impacted Systems: Hundreds of Codecov customer networks including GoDaddy, Atlassian, The Washington Post, Procter & Gamble, IBM, Hewlett Packard Enterprise
Attack Vector: Compromised Docker image credentials used to alter Bash Uploader script
Use of altered Bash Uploader script in customers' continuous integration (CI) environments
Indicators of Compromise: Discrepancy between hash (shashum) of Bash Uploader script on Codecov domain and correct hash on GitHub
Altered Bash Uploader script with replaced IP address
